messages.content:
Assign the three-character ICD-10-AM principal diagnosis category for the episode of care described below. A three-character category is one capital letter followed by exactly two digits, for example J44.

Hospital course:
Hospital Course Summary:

Admission Date: March 10, 2020
Discharge Date: April 7, 2020
Admitting Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Hospital Course: A 50-year-old male patient presented with symptoms of cough and fever lasting for 47 days. The patient was diagnosed with COVID-19 infection based on positive nucleic acid results on February 15th. Prior treatment included arbidol and lianhua qingwen granules. The patient was admitted to Wuhan Huoshenshan Hospital on March 10th with peripheral oxygen saturation of 96% and respiratory rate of 18 breaths/minute. CT findings showed a bilateral, scattered, high-density shadow and fiber- and spine-like opacities. 

During his hospitalization, convalescent plasma from COVID-19 patients, recombinant human interferon, lianhua qingwen granules, arbidol, and chloroquine phosphate were administered. On March 24th, the patient's CT scan showed substantial improvement with no obvious pulmonary lesions. On April 3-5, nucleic acid test results for SARS-CoV-2 were all negative. SARS-CoV-2 IgM and IgG levels were markedly reduced. The patient was discharged from the hospital on April 7th after three consecutively negative SARS-CoV-2 RNA tests. 
Discharge Diagnosis: [diagnosis section withheld]
Discharge Condition: The patient was discharged from the hospital in good condition and stable. The patient was advised to follow COVID-19 prevention protocols and report any symptoms of illness to their primary care provider.

Follow-up Care: Follow-up care was recommended for the patient to monitor their health and recovery progress.

Reply with the three characters only.
